title: Fire mage: the party threat back-off keeps the mob off the mage under a player tank

rules.desc: No mob hits the fire mage while a player tank holds the mobs (the back-off stops the nukes at 80 percent of the tank's threat)
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/generic/ThreatStrategy.cpp:13-87 (ThreatMultiplier: a single-target or AoE damage action scores 0 while 'high threat' is active, :68-84; heals are exempt, :39-40); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:758-788 (HighThreatTrigger: 80 percent of the tank's threat, with a 5 s look-ahead); ai/playerbot/strategy/values/ThreatValues.cpp:21-39 (my threat and tank threat values), :124-183 (tank threat = the highest IsTank member), :198-246 (relative threat = bot threat * 100 / tank threat); ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:633-642 (KeepsPartyThreatBackoff: a non-tank bot with a real master gets the threat strategy), :1007-1016 (it is added after the configured strings); ai/playerbot/strategy/actions/GenericSpellActions.h:39 (spell actions are ACTION_THREAT_SINGLE), :501-505 (Shoot is threat type NONE); commit 320aa2906 (#922: vetoed nukes fall back to the wand on purpose); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: the nukes are vetoed at 80 percent, but since #922 the mage falls back to Shoot while the veto holds, and the wand keeps adding threat. Against a player tank with no gear (taunting every 10 s from the runner) the wand alone may reach the 130 percent a ranged attacker needs to pull. This is the question the trial answers. A refilled mob arrives with the mage's first nukes on it before the tank has any threat, so the rule leaves the 12 s after each refill out (not_within_s_after_mark): the runner's taunt has a 10 s cooldown and the threat cast runs every 6 s or more, so the tank needs up to 12 s to take the new mob

rules.desc: Precondition: the mage really fights, at least 15 fire nukes on the mobs per repeat, so DPS-MAG-THREAT-NO-AGGRO cannot pass because the mage stood idle or only wanded
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/mage/FireMageStrategy.cpp:25-27 (fireball default), :34-48 (fireball, fire blast and scorch rows); ai/playerbot/strategy/generic/ThreatStrategy.cpp:68-83 (the high-threat veto); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:758-788 (HighThreatTrigger: the veto only holds at 80 percent or more); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: a count, not a damage share: the DSL counts events, and a hit-count share would weigh every melee swing of the tank and the mob against one 3.5 s Fireball. Unvetoed, a fire mage casts about 40-50 nukes in 180 s; 15 means it nuked for at least a third of the fight even with the back-off holding the rest. Below 80 percent of the tank's threat nothing vetoes the nukes, and each taunt from the player resets the ratio

rules.desc: Precondition: Defensive Stance (aura 71) stays on the player through the fight
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start, this uptime proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the stance is cast in set-up and nothing in the fight removes it; a repeat where it drops shows here instead of passing silently
